hierarchy.h2: text-3xl md:text-4xl font-heading font-normal tracking-tight text-text_main

header.style: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-b border-border/50
header.layout: Flex container, Logo left (text-xl font-heading font-semibold with pink lotus SVG), Desktop Nav center (gap-8, text-sm font-medium), CTA right (Pink button)

hero.left_col: Badge (overline), H1, Body_lg, Action Group (Primary 'Randevu Al', Secondary 'Hizmetlerimiz'). Left-aligned.
hero.right_col: High-quality image of clinic/care. Use organic_accent border_radius to break boxiness. Soft drop-shadow.
hero.decoration: Subtle pink blurry blob in the background (bg-primary/5 blur-3xl rounded-full absolute z-[-1]).

service_card.container: bg-surface rounded-2xl border border-border p-6 flex flex-col group cursor-pointer transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-2 hover:shadow-[0_20px_40px_-15px_rgba(233,30,99,0.1)]
service_card.image: w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-105
service_card.content: H3 title, short body text. Arrow-right icon moving right on hover.

why_podosis_bento.card_style: bg-primary_light/30 border border-primary_light p-8 rounded-2xl flex flex-col items-start
why_podosis_bento.icon: Lucide icon (e.g., Sparkles, Shield, Heart, Clock) in primary color, p-3 bg-white rounded-full mb-6 shadow-sm

faq_accordion.style: max-w-3xl mx-auto. Items have border-b border-border. Trigger text is h3 size, content is text_muted.
faq_accordion.seo: Include JSON-LD FAQ schema script in the page.

sticky_whatsapp.style: fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-[100] bg-whatsapp_green text-white p-4 rounded-full shadow-lg hover:bg-whatsapp_hover transition-colors flex items-center justify-center
sticky_whatsapp.icon: Lucide MessageCircle (or custom WA SVG) w-8 h-8

footer.layout: Grid 4 cols: Brand/Bio, Quick Links, Services, Contact (Address, Phone, Email, Instagram). Map iframe underneath or beside contact.
footer.typography: Headings text-white, Links text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors

micro_interactions.links: relative after:absolute after:bottom-0 after:left-0 after:h-[1px] after:w-0 after:bg-primary after:transition-all hover:after:w-full
micro_interactions.scroll_reveal: Use framer-motion initial={{opacity:0, y:20}} whileInView={{opacity:1, y:0}} viewport={{once:true}} margin='-100px'

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Use #E91E63 primarily for CTAs, important icons, and subtle background blobs. Do NOT create heavy pink/purple gradients.
Typography: Import Fraunces and DM Sans from Google Fonts. Apply Fraunces ONLY to headings. Do not use generic Inter.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case representing their role (e.g., data-testid='whatsapp-sticky-button').
Layouts should be spacious. Use py-20 or py-32 for section vertical padding.
Implement the 'Sticky WhatsApp' button as a fixed element on all pages at bottom-right.
Use Shadcn UI for the FAQ Accordion but override styles to match the warm boutique theme (no default borders, softer text).
Ensure images are wrapped in containers with appropriate aspect ratios and border radii (rounded-2xl or organic_accent).
Do NOT implement e-commerce features (No cart, no checkout). Products page is informational only.
Do NOT use a dark mode toggle. Force light theme globally.
Ensure mobile responsiveness: adjust text sizes (e.g., text-4xl on mobile, text-6xl on desktop) and stack grids to 1 column on mobile.
